title: Causes of training/serving skew
summary: What makes production features differ from training features.

choices.text: The training pipeline computes "average order value" in SQL; the serving code reimplements it in Java and treats refunds differently.
Training used features joined from a daily snapshot taken after each event, while serving reads the value as of the request.
A feature is missing at serving time when a cache times out, and the service fills in 0, a value that never appeared in training.
The model was trained with a different random seed than the previous model.
Text is lower-cased by the training tokenizer but not by the serving tokenizer.
